correctness.rationale: Order three iid U(0,1) knots a=u<b=u+s<c=u+s+t; ordered density is 6. Substitution into the three exact Lagrange formulas gives reproduction of 1,z,z² (independently checked symbolically). In each region one small gap is much smaller than the other, W~sqrt(2)(z-u)^2/(s t). The one-gap area with 0<s<eta t<eta is C log T/(2T)+O_eta(1/T), twice for opposite hierarchy; events with a gap bounded away from zero or two comparable tiny gaps are only O(1/T), and exceptional u-regions contribute arbitrarily little after normalization. The coefficient is 6sqrt(2) int_0^1(z-u)^2du=6sqrt(2)(z²-z+1/3); at z=1/2 it is sqrt(2)/2. Layer cake yields p<1 precisely; independent centered Gaussian errors inherit the norm moments. Symbolic Lagrange reproduction, gap residues and midpoint coefficient were independently checked; Monte Carlo diagnostic not rerun.
residual_risks: The limit is pointwise in deterministic z and fixed n=3, with no uniform-in-degree or nonuniform-node-density result.
